_readme: Edit this file to change self-register email rules. Auth Gateway loads it (restart or SIGHUP not required on next request if AUTH_REGISTER_POLICY_HOT_RELOAD=1; default reloads mtime). Env AUTH_REGISTER_EMAIL_* still overrides when set. Docs: docs/docs/develop/unified-login.md §注册风控
_mode: allowlist = only domains in allowlist; blocklist = allow all except blocklist; off = no domain allowlist (disposable blocklist still applies unless blocklist is empty)
_allowlist_hint: Add corporate domains here, e.g. "acme.com". Lowercase host only, no @.
_blocklist_hint: Disposable / throwaway hosts. Applied even when mode is off (unless you clear this array).
_limits_hint: ipDailyLimit = register starts per IP per UTC day; codeHourlyLimit = Register verification codes per IP per hour. Set 0 to disable that limit. Env AUTH_REGISTER_IP_DAILY_LIMIT / AUTH_REGISTER_CODE_IP_HOURLY_LIMIT override when set.
